description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_signed_norm_D2_extrapolate_bc, the level-set REINITIALISATION gradient norm (fire_behavior Advance_ls_reinit, fire_upwinding_reinit = 4). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge, the smallest even size on which every region is non-empty), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit byte-identical canonical bytes, which the golden pins: the COMPOUND gradient magnitude sqrt((D(u,x))^2 + (D(u,y))^2) (priority 20) replaced by the rule's body -- sqrt(Mx^2 + My^2) with Mx, My the family's per-axis frames (rules/weno5_eno1_D1x_extrapolate_frame, rules/weno5_eno1_D1y_extrapolate_frame) around stencils/weno5_eno1_signed_D1x_interior and stencils/weno5_eno1_signed_D1y_interior with their sign param s bound to the free name upwind_sign -- with all metaparameters folded and zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in the equations. The golden is the reference-preserving lowered form (esm-spec 9.6.4): match-less template references in the rule body (the frames, the interior and point stencils) survive as resolved apply_expression_template leaves and the imported template registry is part of the golden, so the golden pins the whole composition, not only the equations. Free names left symbolic: dx, dy, upwind_sign, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells. This fixture declares NO wind_u/wind_v: the reinitialisation picks its upwind side from the frozen sign field, and the golden records every name the lowered body reads, so a regression in which the rule read a wind would change the bytes (and leave an unresolved name). upwind_sign = 1 is a constant [x, y] field -- the ast category compares the lowered AST symbolically, so the value only has to resolve the name. The golden also pins the SIGNED band test u >= weno_band_cells * dx of the reinitialisation stencils (the reference's lfn_curr(i, j) < threshold_hlu, reproduced without the abs() that Calc_tend_ls has). bdy_eno1_cells = 3, weno_band_cells = 4 (parameters); x0=y0=0, dx=dy=1/8 spelled with the literal 8 (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm contract). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
